message.content:
You are validating and hardening a just-completed rework of the Nxeon live-chat AI agent in /opt/nxeon (Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma). Another process is editing UNRELATED tracking/pixel files — do NOT touch anything outside the chat/knowledge-base files listed below.

## What was just changed (do not redo — verify and fix only)
The live-chat bot was reworked from a "LLM-or-dumb-keyword-retrieval-fallback" design into a real agent that runs an agentic tool loop for EVERY visitor, with a graceful degradation path (never dumps blog snippets). Files changed:
- **lib/kb-tools.ts**: added `import { PLAN_CARDS } from "@/lib/kb-plans"`. Added a new account write-tool `open_support_ticket` to `ACCOUNT_TOOLS`. Added `export const PUBLIC_TOOLS` (tools `check_platform_status`, `get_plans`, `search_help`). Added `export function chatToolsFor(userId)`, `export async function runChatTool(userId, name, input)`, `export async function runPublicTool(name, input)`. Added impls `openTicket()`, `platformStatus()` (queries db.statusIncident where resolvedAt:null + db.announcement active), `planCatalog()`, `searchHelp()` (raw FTS over KbChunk). The original 6 read-only ACCOUNT_TOOLS + `runAccountTool` are unchanged and still exported.
- **lib/kb-llm.ts**: removed the `askClaude` import (now only `askClaudeWithTools`). Added `DEFAULT_BOT_MODEL="claude-sonnet-4-6"` and `export type LlmResult = {ok:true;text:string} | {ok:false;reason:"no_key"|"empty"|"error";detail?:string}`. `buildSystem` now builds a `toolsBlock` (different text for signed-in vs anon) and `accountBlock=""`. `llmAnswer(...)` now returns `Promise<LlmResult>` and ALWAYS calls `askClaudeWithTools` with `tools: chatToolsFor(uid)` and `execTool: (name,input)=>runChatTool(uid,name,input)`.
- **lib/kb.ts**: removed the entire keyword-retrieval fallback (snippet dump, CLARIFIERS, OFFER_NUDGE/OFFER_REPLY, fallbackPlanCards, CONFIDENCE/FAQ_BOOST). Added `degradedReply(reason,name)`. `ReplyKind` now = `"smalltalk"|"handoff"|"offer"|"answer"|"degraded"` (removed `"none"`). `KbResult` gained optional `llmFailure?: "no_key"|"error"|"over_cap"`. `kbAnswer` now: humanIntent→handoff; noLlm→degraded(over_cap); else run llmAnswer; ok→answer/offer; failure→greeting (if no_key+greeting) or degraded. Still imports `greetingIntent, greetingReply` from kb-smalltalk (dropped `smalltalk`).
- **lib/kb-run.ts**: the KbBotLog create now uses `kind: result.llmFailure === "error" ? "llm_error" : result.kind`.
- **lib/actions-kb.ts**: `kbActivity()` now also returns `llmErrors24h: number` (count of kind="llm_error" in last 24h).
- **components/admin/settings/KbAssistantCard.tsx**: `Activity` type gained `llmErrors24h: number`; added a red warning banner when `act.llmErrors24h > 0`.

## Your job (ONLY these files + their direct dependents)
1. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` (NOT `npm run build` — that clobbers the live prod .next; never build). It will report errors across the whole project; FOCUS on errors in the files above and any file that imports symbols that changed.
2. **Fix any type errors** introduced by these changes. Likely things to check:
   - Anything that still imports the removed `"none"` ReplyKind, or the removed `smalltalk` from kb.ts, or `fallbackPlanCards`, or expects `llmAnswer` to return `string|null` (it now returns `LlmResult`). Grep the repo for other importers of `llmAnswer`, `kbAnswer`, `ACCOUNT_TOOLS`, `runAccountTool`, `PUBLIC_TOOLS`, `ReplyKind`, `KbResult`.
   - `app/api/chat/upload/route.ts` and `app/api/chat/route.ts` call `runAssistant` (in kb-run) — verify they still typecheck.
   - Prisma field names in the new tools: `db.statusIncident` (fields component/severity/title/body/startedAt/resolvedAt), `db.announcement` (active/startsAt/expiresAt/level/title/body), `db.ticket.create` with nested `messages:{create:{authorId,body,isStaff}}`. If any Prisma model/field name is wrong, tsc will flag it — fix to match prisma/schema.prisma.
   - Only report/fix REAL errors from these changes; do not "fix" pre-existing unrelated errors elsewhere (note them but leave them).
3. **Add one focused test** in the test/ directory (follow the existing test style/runner — check package.json test script and an existing test file first). Cover: (a) `runChatTool(null, "check_platform_status", {})` and `runPublicTool` route public tools without a user; (b) `runChatTool(null, "list_services", {})` returns the "please sign in" string (not a throw); (c) `degradedReply` never contains "http" blog links but does offer help — actually just assert it returns a non-empty string mentioning contact/pricing. Keep it lightweight and hermetic (mock Prisma if the existing tests do; if account tools need a DB, only test the pure/public routing that doesn't hit the DB, e.g. the sign-in-required guard and degradedReply). Run the test and make it pass.
4. Do NOT edit tracking/pixel/consent/registration/layout files (another agent owns those). Do NOT run the app build or deploy scripts.

## Report back
(a) The final `npx tsc --noEmit` status for the changed files (clean, or the remaining errors with reasons if they're pre-existing/unrelated). (b) Every fix you made (file + what). (c) The test you added and its pass/fail result. (d) Any correctness concern you spotted in the rework (e.g. a Prisma field mismatch, a missing await, an import cycle). Be precise with file:line.

Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. - figma:figma-implement-motion: Translates Figma motion and animations into production-ready application code. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.

input.tldr: The chat-agent rework removed the "none" reply kind, so the admin "Top unanswered" panel and the "Draft from gaps" learning loop now always return zero. Their SQL still filters WHERE kind = 'none', which is never logged anymore.

In /opt/nxeon (Next.js + Prisma), the live-chat agent rework removed the "none" ReplyKind and the keyword-retrieval fallback. lib/kb-run.ts now only ever logs KbBotLog.kind values of: smalltalk, handoff, offer, answer, degraded, or llm_error. It NEVER logs "none" anymore.
